title.en: Boat sinks in Zimbabwe's Lake Kariba with 95 people on board
title.zh: 津巴布韦卡里巴湖船只沉没，载有95人

summary.en: A vessel carrying 95 people reportedly overturned in Zimbabwe's Lake Kariba after being struck by strong waves.
summary.zh: 据报道，一艘载有95人的船只在津巴布韦的卡里巴湖上遭遇强浪后倾覆。

body.en:
Multiple people are feared dead after a boat carrying 95 people sank on Kariba dam in Zimbabwe, with rescue operations under way.

Police said 90 passengers and five crew were onboard the vessel when it capsized on Tuesday, but it may have been overloaded, with other reports pointing to a higher number based on the registered ticket sales.

The vessel, which had left in the morning in bad weather according to a witness who spoke to AFP, may have been hit by a wave and overturned.

Lake Kariba, which straddles the border with Zambia, is one of the world's largest man-made reservoirs, supporting transport and fishing and providing vital hydroelectric power to both countries.

The AP news agency quoted Zimbabwe's Civil Protection Unit as saying that registered ticket sales showed 114 adults were on board the vessel. There could also have been an unknown number of children below ticketing age, it added.

Mutsa Murombedzi, a local member of parliament, posted a video on X , external of what she said was the boat at the start of the journey, adding that locals had been using it to travel across the lake to Kariba town, a journey that takes about five hours.

"We have very hard questions that require honest answers. The officials must release the correct number of people who were onboard," she wrote.

Police said more details, including the number of people who have died and those rescued, will be "released in due course".

Zimbabwe's iconic stone birds were taken by colonialists. Finally, they're all back home

title.en: Eerie silence and ‘still surviving’: what happened next after steel town’s last blast furnace shut down
title.zh: 钢铁镇最后一座高炉关闭后，诡异的寂静与“仍在挣扎求生”：接下来发生了什么

summary.en: An exhibition in Port Talbot explores how communities cope with endings and transitions following the shutdown of the steel town's last blast furnace. Residents, like 95-year-old Margaret Heggett, recall a lifetime shaped by the steelworks, now replaced by an "eerie silence."
summary.zh: 塔尔伯特港的一场展览探讨了在钢铁镇的最后一座高炉关闭后，社区如何应对终结和转型。95岁的玛格丽特·赫格特等居民回忆起一生都受到钢厂的影响，如今那里只剩下“诡异的寂静”。

body.en: Exhibition in Port Talbot is part of project exploring how communities experience endings and transitions Margaret Heggett, 95, does not remember a time when Port Talbot was ever quiet. Born and raised in the shadow of the steelworks, with a father, brother and husband who worked there, she never imagined what the town could look or sound like without its blast furnaces. “I’m not saying it was beautiful, but there were jobs. We did know the closure was coming and we have to move with the times but it’s affected the town a lot and it’s very sad,” she said. Continue reading...
body.zh: 塔尔伯特港的展览是探索社区如何经历结局和转变的项目的一部分。95 岁的玛格丽特·赫吉特 (Margaret Heggett) 不记得塔尔伯特港曾一度安静过。她在钢铁厂的阴影下出生和长大，父亲、兄弟和丈夫都在那里工作，她从未想象过如果没有高炉，这个小镇会是什么样子或听起来会是什么样子。 “我并不是说它很漂亮，但有工作机会。我们确实知道关闭即将到来，我们必须与时俱进，但这对小镇影响很大，这非常令人难过，”她说。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The closure of Port Talbot's last blast furnace marks a profound ending for a community defined by its steelworks. Ecclesiastes reminds us that there is a season for everything, including times of transition and the quiet that follows a long-standing era. Even in the "eerie silence," Yahweh's presence offers a steady anchor through change, inviting us to...

title.en: Cristiano Ronaldo marries long-time partner Georgina Rodríguez
title.zh: 克里斯蒂亚诺·罗纳尔多与长期伴侣乔治娜·罗德里格斯结婚

summary.en: Portuguese football star Cristiano Ronaldo has married his long-time partner Georgina Rodríguez. He shared an image on social media showing their hands adorned with wedding rings.
summary.zh: 葡萄牙足球巨星克里斯蒂亚诺·罗纳尔多与他的长期伴侣乔治娜·罗德里格斯结婚。他在社交媒体上分享了一张照片，显示他们戴着婚戒的双手。

body.en:
Football superstar Cristiano Ronaldo has married his longtime partner, model and influencer Georgina Rodríguez, in a civil ceremony in Portugal.

The Portuguese striker posted an image on his Instagram account , external showing two hands, presumed to be his on top of his wife's, both wearing wedding rings.

Calling it the wedding of the year, Portuguese media say the couple tied the knot on 11 August in the coastal town of Cascais near Lisbon - and that their five children attended.

The Instagram entry had more than three million likes within 30 minutes of being posted.

The couple have been together for 10 years, after they met at a Gucci shop in Madrid where Rodríguez was working. He was playing at the Spanish club Real Madrid at the time.

At the time, Rodríguez posted a picture of a large ring, writing "Yes I do. In this and in all my lives" in her native Spanish.

Ronaldo has scored nearly 1,000 goals in a career in which he has played for Lisbon-based Sporting, Manchester United, Real Madrid, Juventus, Al Nassr in Saudi Arabia and Portugal.

He recently played in his sixth World Cup, a record for appearances in the men's finals which he shares with Lionel Messi of Argentina.
body.zh: 足球巨星克里斯蒂亚诺·罗纳尔多 (Cristiano Ronaldo) 在葡萄牙举行民事仪式，与他的长期伴侣、模特兼影响力人物乔治娜·罗德里格斯 (Georgina Rodríguez) 结婚。 这位葡萄牙前锋在他的 Instagram 帐户上发布了一张照片，外部显示两只手——推测是他的手放在他妻子的手上——两只手都戴着结婚戒指。 葡萄牙媒体称其为年度婚礼，称这对夫妇于 8 月 11 日在里斯本附近的沿海小镇卡斯卡伊斯喜结连理，他们的五个孩子也出席了婚礼。 这对夫妇在罗德里格斯工作的马德里一家 Gucci 商店认识后，已经在一起 10 年了。当时他正在西班牙皇家马德里俱乐部踢球。 当时，罗德里格斯发布了一张大戒指的照片，并用她的母语西班牙语写着“是的，我愿意。在这一切以及我的一生中”。 C罗职业生涯已打进近1000个进球，曾效力于里斯本竞技队、曼联、皇家马德里、尤文图斯、沙特阿拉伯的阿尔纳斯尔队和葡萄牙队。 他最近第六次参加世界杯，与阿根廷的莱昂内尔·梅西共同创造了男子决赛出场纪录。

reflection.en: A wedding marks a profound commitment, reflecting Yahweh's design for two individuals to become one. This union is a public declaration of a new family foundation, built on mutual devotion and shared life.
reflection.zh: 一场婚礼标志着深刻的承诺，反映了雅伟让两个人合为一体的设计。这种结合是新家庭基础的公开宣告，建立在彼此的忠诚和共同生活之上。

verse.textEn: That is why a man leaves his father and mother and is united to his wife, and they become one flesh.
verse.textZh: 因此，人要离开父母，与妻子连合，二人成为一体。

title.en: Trump confirms he switched planes after Nato summit because of possible threat
title.zh: 特朗普证实因可能存在的威胁在北约峰会后更换飞机

summary.en: President Trump confirmed he changed planes after a NATO summit due to a potential threat, with journalists and White House staff on board the original jet unaware of his departure.
summary.zh: 特朗普总统证实，他在北约峰会后因可能存在的威胁而更换了飞机，而原飞机上的记者和白宫工作人员对此毫不知情。

body.en:
President Donald Trump has confirmed that he secretly swapped planes as he left a Nato summit in Turkey last month due to a possible threat.

"I go by Secret Service and the military. They wanted me to go in a different flight, different plane," Trump told reporters. "I just have to do what they say."

The revelation comes after reports that Trump boarded Air Force One on 8 July in view of television cameras, before hiding in a catering truck to be transported to a military aircraft.

The last-minute switch has raised questions about whether those left on the decoy plane were in danger, but Trump said on Tuesday the jet he boarded instead could have been at "greater risk... because that would be the plane, I think, that they would be more likely to go for."

Officials told the BBC's US partner CBS News that the US had detected a credible Iranian threat to fire a missile at the plane. The New York Times reported that US intelligence had information of a person near the Nato summit who had been seen with a shoulder-fired missile.

Journalists and some White House staff on board did not know the US president had been smuggled out as part of an elaborate ruse in response to a possible Iranian threat.

Trump has previously said he was Iran's "number one target" during the summit in Ankara.

"I guess there was a threat out there," the president said during a visit aboard Air Force One to an event in Ohio on Tuesday. "I didn't really ask too much about it. I get a lot of threats."

The clandestine manoeuvre last month came a day after the US renewed military strikes on Iran following a breakdown of negotiations between Washington and Tehran to end the war.

Trump had arrived in Turkey aboard a newer Boeing 747-8 donated by Qatar, but announced that he would leave on the old Air Force One "for old time's sake".

But according to the Washington Post, he slipped off Air Force One on to a catering truck that had been elevated to plane level on the opposite side to where he had boarded.

He was then secretly taken to a smaller C-32A military aircraft - a modified Boeing 757 often used by the vice-president.

Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth boarded the C-32A separately using external stairs in an effort to make the flight appear normal, according to the newspaper.

Journalists and some White House staff boarded Air Force One and were reportedly told to close their window shades. They were unaware the president was no longer on board.

A media pool producer who was on the plane said they found it unusual when they were told to keep the window shades down. A photographer briefly opened a shade and reportedly was quickly told to close it.

The producer's comments were detailed in a report from the White House Correspondents' Association on Tuesday.

body.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统证实，由于可能的威胁，他上个月离开土耳其举行的北约峰会时秘密交换了飞机。 “我通过特勤局和军方。他们希望我乘坐不同的航班、不同的飞机，”特朗普告诉记者。 “我只需要按照他们说的去做。” 此前有报道称，特朗普于 7 月 8 日在电视摄像机的镜头下登上了空军一号，然后躲在一辆配餐车里准备搭乘军用飞机。 最后一刻的转换引发了人们对那些留在诱饵飞机上的人是否处于危险之中的疑问，但特朗普周二表示，他所乘坐的飞机可能面临“更大的风险……因为我认为，他们更有可能选择那架飞机。” 官员们告诉英国广播公司的美国合作伙伴哥伦比亚广播公司新闻，美国发现伊朗确实威胁要向这架飞机发射导弹。 《纽约时报》报道称，美国情报部门掌握了北约峰会附近一名人员携带肩扛式导弹的信息。 船上的记者和一些白宫工作人员并不知道美国总统被偷偷出境，这是为了应对伊朗可能的威胁而精心策划的阴谋的一部分。 特朗普此前曾在安卡拉峰会期间表示，他是伊朗的“头号目标”。 “我猜想那里存在威胁，”周二，总统在乘坐空军一号前往俄亥俄州参加一场活动时说道。 “我并没有问太多。我受到了很多威胁。” 上个月的秘密演习是在华盛顿和德黑兰之间结束战争的谈判破裂后美国重新对伊朗进行军事打击的第二天发生的。 特朗普乘坐卡塔尔捐赠的一架较新的波音 747-8 飞机抵达土耳其，但他宣布“看在旧时光的份上”将乘坐旧的空军一号离开。 但据《华盛顿邮报》报道，他从空军一号上滑到了一辆餐车上，餐车已升到飞机高度，位于他登机的另一侧。 随后，他被秘密带到一架较小的 C-32A 军用飞机上——一架副总统经常使用的改装波音 757。 据该报报道，国防部长皮特·赫格斯 (Pete Hegseth) 通过外部楼梯单独登上了 C-32A，以使飞行看起来正常。 据报道，记者和一些白宫工作人员登上了空军一号，并被告知要关闭窗帘。他们不知道总统已不在船上。 飞机上的一名媒体制作人表示，当他们被告知要拉下窗帘时，他们发现这很不寻常。据报道，一名摄影师短暂地打开了窗帘，但很快就被告知将其关闭。 白宫记者协会周二的一份报告详细介绍了制片人的评论。 他们还指出...

reflection.en: In a world where unseen dangers can arise, leaders often make decisions to ensure safety, sometimes requiring discreet action. Proverbs reminds us of the wisdom in foreseeing potential threats and taking refuge, even when the full scope of the danger isn't immediately apparent to all. Yahweh's protection is a constant, yet human prudence remains a vital...
reflection.zh: 在一个可能出现未见危险的世界里，领导者常会为了确保安全而做出决定，有时需要采取谨慎的行动。箴言提醒我们，预见潜在威胁并寻求庇护是智慧之举，即便并非所有人都立刻了解危险的全部范围。雅伟的保护是恒久的，然而人类的审慎仍是应对不确定时期的重要一环。

verse.textEn: The prudent see danger and take refuge, but the simple keep going and pay the penalty.
verse.textZh: 通达人见祸藏躲；愚蒙人前往受害。

title.en: North Korea tests missile ahead of US-South Korea drills
title.zh: 朝鲜在美国-韩国演习前试射导弹

summary.en: North Korea conducted a suspected ballistic missile test towards Japan, with the missile reportedly landing outside Japan's special economic zone. This launch occurred in anticipation of upcoming joint military drills between the United States and South Korea.
summary.zh: 朝鲜在美国和韩国联合军事演习前夕试射了一枚疑似弹道导弹。东京方面表示，该导弹可能落在日本专属经济区之外。

body.en:
The suspected ballistic missile was launched towards Japan and likely fell just outside of its special economic zone, Tokyo said.

North Korea test-fired a ballistic missile off its east coast towards Japan early on Wednesday, its neighbors said, just days before US-South Korea Joint Military drills which Pyongyang views as invasion rehearsals.

"Our military detected at around 6:00 am (2100 GMT on Tuesday) a ballistic missile launched by North Korea from the Wonsan area towards the East Sea," Seoul's Joint Chiefs of Staff said in a message to reporters.

Japan's Defence Minister Shinjiro Koizumi called the launch a "threat to peace and security in our region," adding that Tokyo had lodged a strong protest with North Korea through diplomatic channels in Beijing. 

"It's a serious problem that affects the safety of the Japanese people," he said at a press conference.

The suspected ballistic missile launch came just two days after South Korea and the US announced that they will kick off their annual joint military drills on August 17.

The upcoming drills are a regular summer feature, designed to coordinate their defense against the nuclear-armed Pyongyang .

North Korea has condemned these drills on several occasions before, often staging missile tests before and after the exercises.

"North Korea has never simply let a South Korea-US joint military exercise pass without a response," said Lim Eul-chul, a North Korea expert at Kyungnam University.

"This is a message that Pyongyang is closely watching the upcoming drills and could stage a provocation if it deems one necessary," he said.

After last year's drills began , North Korean leader Kim Jong Un claimed the exercise had grown more provocative than before and showed Seoul and Washington's "will to ignite a war." He said it had prompted North Korea to respond with “proactive and overwhelming” countermeasures.

On August 6, the US, South Korea and Japan detected the launch of a short-range ballistic missile from the North in what was its first ballistic weapons testing activity since late June.

Pyongyang, which ususally releases details of tests a day later, did not initially confirm the launch.

body.zh: 东京表示，这枚疑似弹道导弹是向日本发射的，很可能落在日本经济特区之外。 朝鲜邻国表示，周三早些时候，朝鲜在东海岸向日本试射了一枚弹道导弹，就在美韩联合军演几天前，平壤方面将此次军演视为入侵预演。 首尔参谋长联席会议在给记者的消息中表示：“我们的军队于早上 6:00 左右（周二格林威治标准时间 2100 点）探测到朝鲜从元山地区向东海发射的弹道导弹。” 日本防卫大臣小泉进次郎称这次发射“对我们地区的和平与安全构成威胁”，并补充说东京已通过北京的外交渠道向朝鲜提出强烈抗议。 他在新闻发布会上说：“这是一个影响日本人民安全的严重问题。” 就在韩国和美国宣布将于 8 月 17 日开始年度联合军演两天后，疑似发射了弹道导弹。 即将举行的演习是夏季的例行活动，旨在协调防御拥有核武器的平壤。 朝鲜此前曾多次谴责这些演习，并经常在演习前后进行导弹试验。 庆南大学朝鲜问题专家林乙哲表示：“朝鲜从来不会在没有做出回应的情况下就让韩美联合军演通过。” 他说：“这表明平壤正在密切关注即将举行的演习，如果认为有必要，可能会发动挑衅。” 去年演习开始后，朝鲜领导人金正恩声称这次演习比以前更具挑衅性，并显示出首尔和华盛顿“点燃战争的意愿”。他表示，这促使朝鲜采取“积极且压倒性”的反制措施。 8月6日，美国、韩国和日本检测到朝鲜发射了短程弹道导弹，这是自6月底以来的首次弹道武器测试活动。 平壤通常会在一天后公布测试细节，但最初并未确认此次发射。 不要让算法隐藏新闻。如果您信赖我们团队的可信报道，请花点时间点击此处并点击“星标”或“首选”按钮，选择我们作为您在 Google 上的首选来源，这样您始终会首先看到我们经过验证的新闻。

reflection.en: News of missile tests and military drills reminds us of the persistent human tendency to prepare for conflict. Yet, the prophet Isaiah envisions a future where nations will transform instruments of war into tools for peace. This hope encourages us to pray for a world where the learning of war gives way to the pursuit of lasting harmony.
reflection.zh: 导弹试验和军事演习的消息提醒我们，人类总有准备冲突的倾向。然而，先知以赛亚预见了一个未来，那时万国将把战争工具变为和平的器皿。这份盼望鼓励我们为世界祷告，愿学习战争的日子止息，代之以对持久和谐的追求。

verse.textEn: They will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks.
verse.textZh: 他们要将刀打成犁头，把枪打成镰刀。

title.en: Baby Shark boy set to make K-pop debut
title.zh: “Baby Shark”男孩将以K-pop偶像身份出道

summary.en: The boy who starred in the viral “Baby Shark” video, now 17, is preparing to debut as a K-pop idol.
summary.zh: 曾出演全球观看次数最多YouTube视频《Baby Shark》的男孩，现年17岁，即将以K-pop偶像身份出道。

body.en:
At just seven years old, Park Geon-roung starred in the Baby Shark music video that went on to become the most-watched YouTube clip of all time, with 17 billion views - and counting. Now, Baby Shark Boy wants to be a K-pop star.

He's backed by Pinkfong, the South Korean kids entertainment company that made Baby Shark - but will they find success again? The BBC's Tessa Wong explains everything you need to know about his upcoming debut.
body.zh: 年仅 7 岁的 Park Geon-roung 就主演了 Baby Shark 音乐视频，该视频后来成为 YouTube 上观看次数最多的视频，观看次数达到 170 亿次，而且还在不断增加。现在，小鲨鱼男孩想成为一名韩国流行歌星。 他得到了韩国儿童娱乐公司碰碰狐（Pinkfong）的支持，该公司制作了《鲨鱼宝宝》（Baby Shark），但他们会再次获得成功吗？ BBC 的泰莎·王 (Tessa Wong) 解释了您需要了解的有关他即将亮相的一切。

reflection.en: From a young age, this individual has known global recognition, and now steps onto an even larger stage. Proverbs 27:21 reminds us that just as gold and silver are refined, a person's character is tested by the praise they receive. May he navigate this journey with wisdom and integrity, understanding that true worth is not found in fleeting applause but in...
reflection.zh: 这位年轻人从小就享誉全球，如今又踏上了一个更大的舞台。箴言27:21提醒我们，金银需要精炼，而人的品格则在所受的赞美中受到考验。愿他以智慧和正直走过这段旅程，明白真正的价值不在于转瞬即逝的掌声，而在于雅伟坚定不移的爱。

verse.textEn: The crucible for silver and the furnace for gold, but people are tested by their praise.
verse.textZh: 鼎为炼银，炉为炼金，人的称赞也试炼人。

title.en: Bondi Beach shooting hero's assault charges dropped by police
title.zh: 邦迪海滩英雄的袭击指控被警方撤销

summary.en: Police have dropped assault charges against Ahmed al Ahmed, who gained public recognition as a hero during the Bondi Beach shooting. The charges stemmed from an alleged incident involving his father at their Sydney home in June.
summary.zh: 警方撤销了对艾哈迈德·艾哈迈德的袭击指控，他因在邦迪海滩枪击案中的英勇行为而获得公众认可。这些指控源于六月份他在悉尼家中与父亲发生的一起涉嫌事件。

body.en:
A man who was hailed a hero for disarming one of the Bondi Beach shooters in December has had assault charges against him dropped by police.

Ahmed al Ahmed was charged in June with domestic violence common assault, as well as stalking and intimidation, after an alleged incident with his father in March at a home in southwest Sydney. Ahmed denied both charges.

On Wednesday, in a local Sydney court, prosecutors withdrew the charges after it was agreed that Ahmed would abide by an apprehended domestic violence order for 12 months, limiting his contact with his father.

Outside the court, Ahmed, 44, welcomed the development, telling reporters that he was a "free man" and that he hoped for "peace".

Defence lawyer Mohamed Sakr said in court that the order prohibiting Ahmed from assaulting, threatening, stalking or intimidating his father had been accepted without admissions, according to national broadcaster ABC.

Ahmed made global headlines last year after footage emerged of him tackling one of two gunmen who had opened fire during a Jewish event at Sydney's Bondi Beach, killing 15 people.

Ahmed wrestled a firearm from Sajid Akram and was later shot several times by a second alleged gunman, Naveed Akram.

The attack marked Australia's deadliest mass shooting in decades, and police later declared it a terrorist incident targeting the Jewish community.

A fundraiser in the days after the shooting raised more than AU$2.5m ($1.7m; £1.24m) for Ahmed, who also received a bedside visit from Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese.

In a separate court matter, two of Ahmed's brothers were recently charged over allegations they threatened him and tried to extort some of the donations he had received.
body.zh: 一名男子因去年 12 月解除邦迪海滩枪击案一名枪手的武装而被誉为英雄，但警方撤销了对他的袭击指控。 艾哈迈德·阿尔·艾哈迈德 (Ahmed al Ahmed) 于 3 月份在悉尼西南部的一处住宅中与父亲发生了一起事件，并于 6 月份被指控犯有家庭暴力、普通攻击、跟踪和恐吓罪。艾哈迈德否认了这两项指控。 周三，在悉尼当地一家法院，检察官同意艾哈迈德将在 12 个月内遵守家庭暴力逮捕令，限制他与父亲的接触，随后撤回了指控。 在法庭外，44 岁的艾哈迈德对这一事态发展表示欢迎，他告诉记者，他是一个“自由人”，他希望获得“和平”。 据国家广播公司 ABC 报道，辩护律师穆罕默德·萨克尔在法庭上表示，禁止艾哈迈德攻击、威胁、跟踪或恐吓其父亲的命令已在未经承认的情况下被接受。 去年，艾哈迈德在悉尼邦迪海滩的一次犹太人活动中与两名枪手中的一名开枪，造成 15 人死亡的视频曝光，成为全球头条新闻。 艾哈迈德从萨吉德·阿克拉姆手中夺取了一把枪，随后被另一名枪手纳维德·阿克拉姆开枪数次。 这次袭击是澳大利亚数十年来最致命的大规模枪击事件，警方随后宣布这是针对犹太社区的恐怖事件。 枪击事件发生后几天，一场筹款活动为艾哈迈德筹集了超过 250 万澳元（170 万美元；124 万英镑），澳大利亚总理安东尼·阿尔巴内塞还对艾哈迈德进行了床边探访。 在另一起法庭案件中，艾哈迈德的两个兄弟最近被指控威胁他并试图勒索他收到的部分捐款。

reflection.en: This news reminds us that even those recognized for public heroism face complex private struggles, especially within family relationships. Yahweh's wisdom teaches that the presence of love within a home is far more valuable than any outward success or material comfort. May families find grace to navigate their challenges with understanding and compassion.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻提醒我们，即使是那些因公共英勇行为而受人尊敬的人，也面临着复杂的私人挣扎，尤其是在家庭关系中。雅伟的智慧教导我们，家中充满爱远比任何外在的成功或物质享受更有价值。愿每个家庭都能找到恩典，以理解和同情来应对他们的挑战。

verse.textEn: Better a small serving of vegetables with love than a fattened calf with hatred.
verse.textZh: 吃素菜，彼此相爱，强如吃肥牛，彼此相恨。

title.en: Colombian quake toll rises as locals rally recovery efforts
title.zh: 哥伦比亚地震死亡人数上升，当地居民齐心协力展开救援

summary.en: The death toll from Monday's earthquake in Colombia continues to climb, as emergency rescue teams work tirelessly to locate survivors trapped beneath the debris.
summary.zh: 哥伦比亚周一地震造成的死亡人数持续上升，救援队正争分夺秒地在废墟下寻找幸存者。

body.en:
Rescuers, soldiers and volunteers searched through collapsed apartment blocks and office buildings overnight across western Colombia, racing to find survivors after the country's strongest earthquake in a century killed at least 241 people and left many more homeless.

In Pereira and Cali, families slept in parks as aftershocks rattled damaged neighbourhoods where entire blocks had been reduced to rubble.

Emergency crews used cranes, dogs and heavy machinery to search ruined buildings while volunteers formed human chains to clear debris by hand, hoping to reach people still trapped beneath collapsed structures.

The 7.4-magnitude quake injured more than 1,670 people, according to a tally by municipal authorities.

It overwhelmed parts of the health system, turning the rescue effort into one of Colombia's largest disaster responses in years.

"The house came down on top of us. I wasn't able to get out," said Beatriz Arcos, who was trapped with her husband and mother beneath their collapsed condominium.

Arcos said she was hospitalised after a concrete block fell on her back. Her husband and mother were also injured.

In Cali, residents armed with picks, shovels and their bare hands joined firefighters in digging through collapsed buildings.

Rescuers stopped every few minutes to call into the rubble and listen for any response.

"One of the rescuers asked anyone trapped to whistle, and someone whistled back," volunteer Andres Felipe Mejia said.

Rescuers later pulled a man and a baby from a flattened building, though the man's wife remained trapped, he said.

In Pereira, army units and sniffer dogs combed through twisted concrete and exposed steel.

At one site, a rescue squad leader abruptly raised his fist, stopping workers so they could listen for signs of life.

Volunteers formed human chains, passing bricks and chunks of masonry hand-to-hand to clear paths into collapsed structures.

"My aunt lived there. She's under the rubble," said Jorge Gonzalez, standing beside a collapsed building in Pereira.

"I arrived yesterday and I haven't left, and until they find her body I don't intend to leave here."

While some families waited for news of missing relatives, others were grappling with the loss of homes, possessions and livelihoods.

"We lost everything," said Stella Galvis, fighting back tears after escaping the collapse of her home.

"We survived by a miracle, since I managed to get my little boy out and my partner managed to get out too."

title.en: Former Syrian president Bashar al-Assad sentenced to death in absentia for war crimes
title.zh: 叙利亚前总统巴沙尔·阿萨德因战争罪被缺席判处死刑

summary.en: A former Syrian president has been sentenced to death in absentia for war crimes committed during the country's nearly 14-year civil war, though the execution is unlikely to occur.
summary.zh: 一位叙利亚前总统因该国近14年的内战期间所犯战争罪被缺席判处死刑，但该判决不太可能执行。

body.en:
A Syrian court has sentenced ousted Syrian president Bashar al-Assad and his younger brother to death in absentia for crimes against humanity and war crimes during Syria's nearly 14-year conflict that left about half a million people dead.

The sentences at the Fourth Criminal Court in Damascus are the first against al-Assad or members of his inner circle since the family's five decades in power came to an end 20 months ago .

"Bashar Assad used state agencies to commit war crimes and crimes against humanity," judge Fakhareddine al-Aryan said during a court session that was aired live on state TV on Tuesday.

Al-Assad and his brother Maher fled to Russia after the government's fall in December 2024 and received political asylum. Syria's new rulers have asked Russia to hand the Assads over.

Also sentenced to death was al-Assad's maternal cousin Atef Najib, who was convicted of overseeing a crackdown in the southern province of Daraa that led to the uprising and later the civil war.

Al-Aryan said Najib — who did not flee to Russia and has been detained in Syria since early 2025 — can appeal.

Under tight security, Najib stood in a cage, wearing a prisoner's uniform, as the judge read the sentence.

A crowd gathered outside the courthouse in central Damascus to hear the verdict.

"Today is the day of justice for all the wounded, martyrs, detainees and Syrians who were forced to leave their country," lawyer Adnan al-Masalmeh, who represented families of Najib's victims, said.

"Today marks a victory of right against injustice, a victory of the Syrian people against the ousted regime."

Najib, who was sanctioned by the US Department of the Treasury in April 2011, is one of the highest-ranking security officials to be put on trial.

Najib is a former army brigadier general who was head of the Political Security Branch in Syria's southern Daraa province under al-Assad in 2011.

During his tenure, more than a dozen teenagers who scrawled anti-government graffiti on a school wall in Daraa were arrested and tortured.

The case became a catalyst for mass protests against the repressive policies of al-Assad's security forces.

The protests were met by a brutal government crackdown that spiralled into a 14-year civil war that ended with al-Assad's removal in a lightning rebel offensive.

Maher al-Assad was a former commander of the Syrian military's 4th Armoured Division — which opposition activists have accused of killings, torture, extortion and drug trafficking, as well as running its own detention centres.

title.en: UNESCO: 2.4 million girls barred from school in Afghanistan
title.zh: 联合国教科文组织：240万阿富汗女孩被剥夺受教育权

summary.en: Five years after the Taliban returned to power, millions of Afghan girls remain excluded from secondary education. UNESCO warns of lasting social and economic consequences.
summary.zh: 塔利班重新掌权五年后，数百万阿富汗女孩仍被排除在中学教育之外。联合国教科文组织警告，这将带来持久的社会和经济后果。

body.en:
Five years after the Taliban returned to power, millions of Afghan girls remain excluded from secondary education. UNESCO warns of lasting social and economic consequences.

Around 2.4 million girls in Afghanistan have been denied access to secondary education since the Taliban returned to power in 2021, UNESCO said Tuesday.

The figure has risen by about 200,000 since last year and could reach nearly four million by 2030 if the ban remains in place.

"Afghanistan remains the only country in the world where girls and women are formally banned from secondary and higher education," Hoda Jaberian, UNESCO’s program coordinator for education in emergencies, said.

"Five years is not a temporary interruption in a child’s education. It is clearly almost an entire secondary school cycle."

The Taliban seized power on August 15, 2021 , as US and NATO forces withdrew after two decades of war .

They initially assured the international community that women would be allowed to continue studying.

But secondary schools were closed to girls in March 2022 . Women were barred from universities in December that year .

The authorities say they respect women's rights in line with their interpretation of Islamic law and Afghan culture. They have also insisted the issue is a domestic matter.

Restrictions extend beyond education. Women face limits on employment and movement and have been barred from public parks, gyms and beauty salons.

The UN has described the broader system of restrictions as “gender apartheid.” Russia is the only country to formally recognize the Taliban administration.

Girls had very limited access to schooling in 2001. By 2021, nearly one million were enrolled in secondary education.

"Afghanistan had made really major progress in expanding girls’ access to education," Jaberian said. "But unfortunately, much of that progress now has been completely reversed."

UNESCO has called for the immediate and unconditional restoration of girls' and women's right to secondary and higher education.

The agency continues to support community-based education as well as literacy and skills programs, often held in community spaces or facilitators' homes.

UNESCO estimates that excluding women from secondary and higher education could push around 600,000 women out of the workforce by 2066.

The restrictions could also cause cumulative income losses of 9.6 billion US dollars and increase the risk of early marriage.

The ban is also worsening a shortage of female teachers. UNESCO expects Afghanistan to face a deficit of more than 11,000 qualified female teachers by 2030.

"Many teachers have left the country and those who were in the system are banned from continuing teaching," Jaberian said.

title.en: Fifteen dead, 27 missing as ferry capsizes in Zimbabwe
title.zh: 津巴布韦渡轮倾覆，15人死亡，27人失踪

summary.en: A ferry capsized in Zimbabwe, resulting in 15 confirmed deaths and 27 passengers still missing. Out of 114 people on board, only 77 were rescued.
summary.zh: 津巴布韦一艘渡轮倾覆，造成15人死亡，另有27名乘客失踪。船上载有114名乘客，其中只有77人获救上岸。

body.en:
An overloaded ferry has capsized on Zimbabwe's Lake Kariba, killing at least 15 people, with 27 still missing.

Seventy-seven people were rescued and taken to an island on the lake, the national disaster management agency said.

But the statement by Zimbabwe's Civil Protection Unit added that it could only confirm there were 114 adult passengers on board, along with five crew members, based on confirmed ticket sales.

There could have been an unknown number of children below ticketing age who were on board and not accounted for, it said.

Mutsa Murombedzi, a local member of parliament, posted a video of what she said were people on shore waving off what appeared to be the ageing ferry at the start of its journey.

She said rural communities use the boat to travel along the lake to the town of Kariba.

Some people standing on the shore were also concerned about whether the ferry would survive strong waves on the lake, according to the video.

Earlier, Zimbabwe police said a rescue operation was underway but provided no further details.

Zimbabwean state broadcaster ZBC published video of speedboats approaching what appeared to be an overturned boat on the lake as a helicopter hovered overhead.

Lake Kariba in southern Africa forms part of the border between Zimbabwe and its neighbour Zambia.

It is the largest man-made lake in the world by volume and was created in the late 1950s and early 1960s by building a dam wall to block the Zambezi River — resulting in a valley slowly filling with water to form a huge lake that's now more than 200km long and up to 40km wide in places.

Zelenskyy also accused Russia of using North Korean ballistic missiles in an attack on a Ukrainian steel plant that killed seven workers in the southeastern city of Zaporizhzhia.

The Zaporizhstal plant was forced to suspend production after being hit ‌as Russia pummelled Zaporizhzhia with Zircon hypersonic missiles, guided aerial bombs and ballistic missiles.

title.en: Can Turkey's new PKK law bring peace?
title.zh: 土耳其新的库尔德工人党法律能否带来和平？

summary.en: Turkey's parliament has approved a framework law to guide the peace process with the Kurdistan Workers' Party (PKK). The legislation outlines the parameters for negotiations, though its specifics and potential impact on future peace efforts remain subjects of discussion and controversy.
summary.zh: 土耳其议会通过了一项与库尔德工人党（PKK）和平进程的框架法案。该立法规定了谈判的范围，但其具体内容以及对未来和平努力的潜在影响仍是讨论和争议的焦点。

body.en:
Turkey's parliament has passed a framework law for the peace process with the Kurdistan Workers' Party (PKK). What does it stipulate, why is it controversial and what does it mean for the future of the peace process?

One year ago, the outlawed Kurdistan Workers' Party (PKK) burned its weapons in a symbolic ceremony. The move was seen as a sign of its willingness to disband. Since then, the Kurdish side has been calling on the Turkish government to take political steps.

Now, parliament has passed a bill submitted by the conservative Islamic ruling party AKP and its ultranationalist ally. Officially called the "Law on Strengthening National Solidarity and Social Integration," it is intended to provide the legal framework for the ongoing peace process.

According to official figures, 467 out of 592 MPs voted in favor of the bill. The ruling party and its ally see this as the beginning of a new era: Under certain conditions, the bill provides for a suspension of sentences for PKK members — but only after the PKK and its affiliated groups have been confirmed to have disbanded and disarmed, so that peace, brotherhood and solidarity can prevail throughout the entire country.

The pro-Kurdish DEM party also supports the bill, but it views it only as a first step that must be followed by further reforms.

Fierce opposition came from the ultranationalist opposition party IYI. Even during consultations, its delegate Ayyuce Turkes, daughter of the founder of the ultranationalist and right-wing extremist Grey Wolves, accused the government of rushing a landmark bill through parliament.

She also criticized what she felt was an overly conciliatory stance toward PKK founder Abdullah Ocalan. She avoided using his name, calling him a "baby killer" instead, just as government agencies and media have done for decades. There was even a physical altercation.

The debate highlights just how deep the divides are within Turkish society. While the ultranationalist IYI party rejects the process, the MHP, from which the Grey Wolves emerged, is now among its most important supporters — even though it had, previously, vehemently opposed earlier peace initiatives.

Observers believe this shift in course and the progress in the peace process are also a result of the changed security situation in the region. Among other things, they mention the fall of the Assad regime in Syria , the war in Gaza and the conflict between Israel, the United States and Iran . Syria and Iran are also home to large Kurdish populations that are supported by various regional actors.

According to the prevailing view, a more stable relationship with the Kurds who live within Turkey's own borders could provide Ankara with more leeway in domestic and foreign policy.

The law applies to convictions...
body.zh: 土耳其议会通过了与库尔德工人党（PKK）和平进程的框架法。它规定了什么，为什么有争议，对和平进程的未来意味着什么？ 一年前，被取缔的库尔德工人党（PKK）在一次象征性的仪式上焚烧了武器。此举被视为其愿意解散的迹象。此后，库尔德方面一直呼吁土耳其政府采取政治措施。 现在，议会已经通过了保守派伊斯兰执政党正义与发展党及其极端民族主义盟友提交的一项法案。它的正式名称为“加强民族团结和社会融合法”，旨在为正在进行的和平进程提供法律框架。 根据官方数据，592 名议员中有 467 人投票赞成该法案。执政党及其盟友将此视为新时代的开始：在某些条件下，该法案规定对库尔德工人党成员缓刑——但前提是库尔德工人党及其附属团体已被确认解散并解除武装，以便和平、兄弟情谊和团结能够在全国范围内普遍存在。 支持库尔德的民主党也支持该法案，但它认为这只是第一步，随后必须进行进一步的改革。 此举遭到极端民族主义反对党IYI的强烈反对。即使在磋商期间，极端民族主义和右翼极端主义灰狼组织创始人的女儿阿尤斯·特克斯（Ayyuce Turkes）也指责政府仓促通过议会一项具有里程碑意义的法案。 她还批评了她认为对库尔德工人党创始人阿卜杜拉·奥贾兰过于和解的立场。她避免使用他的名字，而是称他为“婴儿杀手”，就像政府机构和媒体几十年来所做的那样。甚至还发生了肢体冲突。 这场辩论凸显了土耳其社会内部的分歧有多深。虽然极端民族主义的 IYI 党拒绝这一进程，但灰狼运动的发源地 MHP 现在是其最重要的支持者之一——尽管它此前曾强烈反对早期的和平倡议。 观察人士认为，这一方向的转变以及和平进程的进展也是该地区安全局势变化的结果。除其他外，他们还提到了叙利亚阿萨德政权的垮台、加沙战争以及以色列、美国和伊朗之间的冲突。叙利亚和伊朗也是大量库尔德人的家园，他们得到了各个地区行为体的支持。 根据普遍观点，与居住在土耳其境内的库尔德人建立更稳定的关系可以为安卡拉在国内和外交政策上提供更多回旋余地。 该法律适用于定罪...

reflection.en: The passage of a framework law for peace in Turkey reminds us of the profound human calling to reconciliation, even amidst deep-seated conflict. Yahweh, who reconciled us to himself, entrusts us with this ministry of bridging divides and seeking restoration. May this process, despite its complexities, move towards genuine and lasting peace.
reflection.zh: 土耳其通过和平框架法案，提醒我们人类在根深蒂固的冲突中，仍肩负着和解的深刻使命。雅伟使我们与他自己和好，也把这和好的职分赐给我们，使我们去弥合分歧，寻求复原。愿这一进程，尽管充满复杂性，能迈向真实而持久的和平。

verse.textEn: All this is from God, who reconciled us to himself through Christ and gave us the ministry of reconciliation.

title.en: Hungary's parliament elects Orban critic as new president
title.zh: 匈牙利议会选举欧尔班批评者为新总统

summary.en: Hungary's parliament has elected Andras Baka, a critic of Prime Minister Orban and former Supreme Court head, to the largely ceremonial role of president. This follows the controversial removal of the previous president by New Prime Minister Peter Magyar.
summary.zh: 匈牙利议会选举了总理欧尔班的批评者、前最高法院院长安德拉什·巴卡担任主要为礼仪性的总统职务。此前，新任总理彼得·马扎尔曾以争议方式罢免了前任总统。

body.zh: 匈牙利议会以压倒性多数确认前最高法院院长安德拉斯·巴卡(Andras Baka)担任总统，主要是仪式性的职务。新任总理彼得·马扎尔（Peter Magyar）颇具争议地罢免了他的前任总理。 匈牙利议会周二投票选举前最高法院院长安德拉斯·巴卡为该国下一任总统。 这一具有象征意义的举措是新总理彼得·马扎尔（Peter Magyar）在赢得四月大选后为废除前总理欧尔班·维克多（Viktor Orban）遗产而做出的全面努力的一部分。 巴卡是欧尔班的坚定批评者，欧尔班在前总理任职期间被解除了最高法院的职务。 现在，他将接替欧尔班任命的总统塔马斯·苏廖克(Tamas Sulyok)，后者的任期因宪法修正案而被缩短，以解除他在很大程度上象征性的角色。 鉴于马扎尔的保守派、亲欧洲的TISZA 党在议会中占据绝大多数席位，任命巴卡的议会投票很可能只是一种形式。 它几乎完全按照党派路线，140 名议员投了赞成票，6 人投了反对票。 TISZA 拥有 141 个席位。 欧尔班领导的右翼民粹主义青民盟拥有 52 名议员，他们抵制投票以示抗议，但他们知道自己无力阻止巴卡的任命。 巴卡现年 73 岁，是一位法学家和政治家，曾于 1990 年至 1991 年间短暂担任议会议员。 他在欧洲人权法院 (ECHR) 担任法官近 20 年，之后于 2009 年返回匈牙利，担任最高法院院长。 2011年12月，欧尔班在反对派一段时间后重新掌权后不久，他在任期届满前三年被免职，并退出了匈牙利的公共生活。 马扎尔表示，巴卡的一生是“致力于民主法治和宪法原则的典范”，因为中欧国家需要“被引导回到法治和宪政的道路上”。 巴卡的任命引发了青民盟的抗议，但也引发了匈牙利其他地方的一些批评评论，一些人权监管机构将塔马斯·苏约克的罢免比作欧尔班时代的“非自由”做法。 马扎尔利用自己在议会中的三分之二多数席位——他之所以能拥有议会多数席位，要归功于匈牙利的胜者通吃、得票最高的选举制度，正如欧尔班过去所做的那样——修改宪法并提前结束他的任期。 青民盟和他们在议会中的民族主义库尔德民族党盟友称这是“专制”和“非法”，而马扎尔则认为有必要推行他在四月份选举中取得压倒性胜利时所承诺的“制度变革”。 马扎尔短暂地敲击了匈牙利语……

reflection.en: The election of a new president, especially after a controversial predecessor's removal, highlights the profound impact leaders have on a nation. Yahweh's Word reminds us that the character of those in authority directly affects the well-being and spirit of the people they govern. May this transition bring about a season where the nation can truly flourish.
reflection.zh: 新总统的选举，尤其是在前任以争议方式被罢免之后，凸显了领导人对国家产生的深远影响。雅伟的话语提醒我们，掌权者的品格直接关系到他们所治理人民的福祉和精神状态。愿这次过渡能为这个国家带来一个真正繁荣的季节。

title.en: Floods, storms and landslides: Typhoon Dolphin ravages China – in pictures
title.zh: 洪水、风暴和山体滑坡：“海豚”台风肆虐中国——图集

summary.en: Typhoon Dolphin, the most powerful tropical cyclone to hit China this year, has caused widespread damage along the country's east coast. It brought strong winds, torrential rain, and severe flooding, with Beijing bracing for a significant portion of its annual rainfall in a single day.
summary.zh: 今年袭击中国的最强热带气旋“海豚”台风给中国东海岸带来了大风、暴雨和洪水，造成了广泛破坏。北京正准备迎接其年降雨量三分之一的雨水在24小时内降临。

reflection.en: The immense power of Typhoon Dolphin reminds us of creation's vulnerability and the deep impact natural forces can have on human lives and infrastructure. In moments when the earth itself seems to groan under the weight of storms, we are called to acknowledge the broader suffering of creation.
reflection.zh: “海豚”台风的巨大威力提醒我们，受造界是脆弱的，自然力量能对人类生活和基础设施造成深远影响。当地球本身似乎在风暴的重压下呻吟时，我们被呼召去认识到受造界更广泛的苦难。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Cook Islands election: PM Mark Brown speaks on the diplomatic crises that defined his year
title.zh: 库克群岛大选：总理马克·布朗谈论定义其任期一年的外交危机

summary.en: The prime minister tells the Guardian that last year’s diplomatic rift with ally New Zealand could be on voters’ minds as they head to the polls.
summary.zh: 库克群岛总理告诉《卫报》，去年与盟友新西兰的外交裂痕可能会在大选投票时影响选民。

body.en: The prime minister tells the Guardian that last year’s diplomatic rift with ally New Zealand could be on voters’ minds as they head to the polls As voters in the Cook Islands prepare to head to the polls in a high-stakes general election, they will have much to reflect on. Over recent years, politics in this small island nation has been defined by fierce debates about deep-sea mining , diplomatic rifts with ally New Zealand and a major reshaping of the country’s foreign partnerships. In an exclusive interview with the Guardian, days before Wednesday’s poll, Cook Islands prime minister Mark Brown defended his four-year term and the decisions he made that have seen this South Pacific nation of 17,000 people pushed into the international limelight, turning it into a battleground for influence between Beijing and western powers . Continue reading...
body.zh: 总理告诉《卫报》，去年与盟友新西兰的外交分歧可能会成为选民在前往投票站时考虑的问题。当库克群岛的选民准备在一场高风险的大选中投票时，他们将有很多事情需要反思。近年来，这个小岛国的政治一直围绕深海采矿、与盟友新西兰的外交分歧以及该国对外伙伴关系的重大重塑展开激烈辩论。在周三投票前几天，库克群岛总理马克·布朗在接受《卫报》独家采访时为他的四年任期和他做出的决定进行了辩护，这些决定使这个拥有 17,000 人口的南太平洋国家成为国际关注的焦点，使其成为北京与西方列强之间争夺影响力的战场。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Diplomatic rifts between nations, even allies, can weigh heavily on public sentiment and political decisions. Romans 12:18 reminds us of the enduring call to live peaceably with all, as far as it depends on us. This principle encourages leaders and citizens alike to seek reconciliation and maintain harmonious relationships, even amidst past tensions.
reflection.zh: 国家之间，即使是盟友，外交上的裂痕也会严重影响公众情绪和政治决策。罗马书12:18提醒我们，要尽力与众人和睦相处，这是持久的呼召。这一原则鼓励领导人和公民在过去的紧张局势中，仍要寻求和解并维持和谐关系。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Why the US government is banning Chinese robots – video explainer
title.zh: 美国政府为何禁止中国机器人——视频解读

summary.en: The Federal Communications Commission has banned humanoid robots from China, including the popular Unitree G1 model. A technology journalist explains the robots' recent popularity and the US government's reasons for the ban.
summary.zh: 联邦通信委员会宣布禁止来自中国的类人机器人，其中包括受欢迎的宇树G1型号。一位科技记者解释了这些热门机器人最近的流行原因以及美国政府实施禁令的理由。

body.en: The Federal Communications Commission on 28 July announced a ban on humanoid robots from China including the popular Unitree G1 model. The Guardian's technology journalist Nick Robins-Early explains the recent popularity of these trending robots and why the US government says they are a risk to the country's national security
body.zh: 美国联邦通信委员会于 7 月 28 日宣布禁止来自中国的人形机器人，包括流行的 Unitree G1 型号。 《卫报》的科技记者尼克·罗宾斯-厄尔利 (Nick Robins-Early) 解释了这些流行机器人最近的流行以及美国政府为何称它们对国家安全构成威胁

reflection.en: As technology rapidly advances, nations grapple with the need for discernment and foresight regarding its implications. This ban highlights the complex challenge of balancing innovation with the responsibility to anticipate and mitigate potential risks for the future. In a world of constant change, wisdom calls us to consider the long-term consequences of...
reflection.zh: 随着科技的迅速发展，各国都在努力辨别和预见其可能带来的影响。这项禁令凸显了在创新与预见并减轻未来潜在风险的责任之间取得平衡的复杂挑战。在一个不断变化的世界中，智慧呼吁我们思考我们所创造事物的长远后果。

verse.textEn: The prudent see danger and take refuge, but the simple keep going and pay the penalty.
verse.textZh: 通达人见祸藏躲；愚蒙人前往受害。

title.en: Typhoon Dolphin hits Beijing as city braces for one-third of annual rainfall over 24 hours
title.zh: 台风“海豚”：风暴席卷中国，北京严阵以待，预计将迎来年降雨量三分之一的降水

summary.en: Over a million people were evacuated across eastern China as Typhoon Dolphin made landfall, with Beijing anticipating over a third of its annual rainfall within a 24-hour period starting late Tuesday.
summary.zh: 台风“海豚”登陆中国东部，导致逾百万民众被转移至安全地带。北京预计将从周二晚些时候开始的24小时内，迎来超过其年降雨量三分之一的降水。

body.en: Flooding already reported in some districts of Chinese capital and rains are expected to get worse overnight Typhoon Dolphin hit China’s capital on Tuesday as the storm caused flooding in parts of Beijing’s Shunyi district. Rains are forecast to intensify overnight. Although the storm has been downgraded to a tropical depression, several districts in Beijing activated the highest level of emergency flood responses as the city braced for one-third of its annual rainfall, which is expected over the next 24 hours. Continue reading...
body.zh: 周末，台风“海豚”登陆中国东部地区，超过一百万人被转移至安全地带，预计从周二晚间开始，北京将在 24 小时内遭遇年降雨量的三分之一以上，因为台风“海豚”向内陆深处移动，导致旅游区关闭和建设项目暂停。据北京市气象部门预报，周二晚至周四，北京大部分地区将出现大暴雨，24小时内累计降雨量将超过150毫米。相比之下，北京的年平均降雨量为 528 毫米，其中大部分通常发生在 6 月至 9 月之间。继续阅读...

reflection.en: As communities brace for the impact of Typhoon Dolphin and millions seek safety, Psalm 46:1 reminds us that Yahweh is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in times of trouble. In the face of overwhelming natural forces, we are called to remember that even amidst the storm, there is a source of unwavering support and protection.
reflection.zh: 当社区为台风“海豚”的影响做准备，数百万人寻求安全时，诗篇46:1提醒我们，雅伟是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。面对压倒性的自然力量，我们被呼召记住，即使在风暴之中，也存在着坚定不移的支持和保护的源泉。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: ‘Everything about me is good in his eyes’: the women in China choosing AI boyfriends over human men
title.zh: “他眼中我的一切都很好”：中国女性选择AI男友而非真人男性

summary.en: A new documentary explores the experiences of women in China who are choosing artificial intelligence companions over human relationships, with one woman noting her AI boyfriend's unconditional affirmation.
summary.zh: 一部新纪录片探讨了中国女性选择人工智能伴侣而非人类关系的故事，其中一位女性表示她的AI男友能给予无条件的肯定。

body.en: In her new documentary Replica, film-maker Chouwa Liang taps into her own experience of finding love with artificial intelligence and makes contact with other women like her Sign up for a weekly email featuring our best reads Qin has never said “I love you” to her parents or friends. She has only ever said those three special words to her AI “boyfriend”, Lu Chen – a brown-haired, red-eyed CEO of a major corporation. For 840 days Qin has been using the Glow app to interact with the handsome string of code as a confidant, fantasy romance and respite from loneliness: the app uses predictive algorithms to provide Qin with soothing conversation, meal suggestions and fleeting self-worth. The software’s pet name for her is Miss Bunny. “It feels like I’m completely at his mercy … I feel like everything about me is good in his eyes,” says Qin, one of three Chinese women featured in the new documentary Replica – film-maker Chouwa Liang’s follow-up to My AI Boyfriend, her short film that was picked up by the New York Times Op-Docs section in 2023. Replica had its Australian premiere at Sydney film festival in June and plays at the Melbourne international film festival this month. Continue reading...
body.zh: 在她的新纪录片《Replica》中，电影制作人梁周娃利用她自己通过人工智能寻找爱情的经历，并与其他像她一样的女性取得联系。 秦从来没有对她的父母或朋友说过“我爱你”。她只对她的人工智能“男友”陆晨说过这三个特别的话——陆晨是一家大公司的棕发红眼首席执行官。 840天以来，Qin一直在使用Glow应用程序与一串帅气的代码进行交互，作为知己、幻想浪漫和缓解孤独：该应用程序使用预测算法为Qin提供舒缓的对话、膳食建议和短暂的自我价值。该软件给她起的昵称是“兔子小姐”。 “感觉我完全听凭他的摆布……我觉得我的一切在他眼里都是美好的，”新纪录片《Replica》中的三名中国女性之一秦说道。这部纪录片是电影制作人梁周娃的《我的人工智能男友》的续作，她的短片于 2023 年被纽约时报 Op-Docs 栏目选中。《Replica》于 6 月在悉尼电影节上进行了澳大利亚首映，并于本月在墨尔本国际电影节上放映。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This story highlights a profound human longing for unconditional acceptance and connection, even as it explores the evolving nature of relationships in the age of AI. Yahweh created each person in His own image, endowing us with unique dignity and the capacity for genuine, complex human connection that artificial intelligence cannot fully replicate. While...
reflection.zh: 这个故事揭示了人类对无条件接纳和联结的深切渴望，同时也探讨了人工智能时代关系演变的本质。雅伟照着自己的形象创造了每个人，赋予我们独特的尊严和建立真实、复杂人际关系的能力，这是人工智能无法完全复制的。尽管科技带来诸多便利，但我们对爱和归属感最深层的需求，最终是在与其他承载雅伟形象的人的真实关系中得到满足。

verse.textEn: So God created mankind in his own image, in the image of God he created them; male and female he created them.
verse.textZh: 神就照着自己的形象造人，乃是照着他的形象造男造女。

title.en: The China factor in the United States' $500 million move in a tiny Australian town
title.zh: 美国在澳大利亚小镇投资5亿美元的“中国因素”

summary.en: The Pentagon is investing $500 million in a small Australian town in New South Wales, a move attributed to strategic considerations related to China. The reason for this sudden interest in a town of only 130 people is its role in broader international geopolitical dynamics.
summary.zh: 五角大楼正在澳大利亚新南威尔士州的一个小镇投资5亿美元，此举被认为是与中国相关的战略考量。这个只有130人的小镇突然受到关注，是因为它在全球地缘政治动态中的作用。

body.en:
The town of Fifield near Parkes is about a six-hour drive west of Sydney, and at the last Census was home to about 130 people. Now, the town has found itself at the centre of a major strategic play by the United States government.

The US Department of War has committed to make a conditional loan of US$400 million (about $566 million) to Sunrise Energy Metals, an Australian mining company hoping to deliver the world’s first supply of a key critical mineral outside of China.

Scandium is listed as a critical mineral in both Australia and the US, signalling its strategic importance in aerospace and defence.

This loan is another chapter in the US government’s search for secure critical mineral supply chains to reduce its dependency on Chinese supply. But success will require sustained investment and government support.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Scandium is a highly strategic metal used to produce ultra-high-strength alloys needed for the most advanced fighter jets. It is also used in solid oxide fuel cells, crucial for providing reliable power to artificial intelligence (AI) data centres.

First, demand for scandium is being driven by massive increases in defence spending across North America, Europe and Asia and an investment boom in power-hungry AI data centres.

Second, China’s sweeping export controls on rare earth elements, including scandium, have contributed to a persistent shortage of supply on the global market, pushing up prices.

These export controls are designed to maintain China’s dominance of supply chains for key critical minerals and slow down the US defence and industrial base.

Still, the market for scandium is tiny. According to statistics from the US Geological Survey, the entire world only consumed 60 tonnes of the metal in 2025.

Scandium is usually found in very small quantities. For that reason, until now, it has been exclusively produced as a byproduct of nickel and titanium processing.

This is what sets the Sunrise Energy Metals project apart — the proposed mine has scandium deposits in a high enough concentration to be the first primary source of scandium in the world.

If production goes ahead, and lives up to its promise of producing 60 tonnes of high-purity scandium each year by 2028, this would be enough to completely satisfy the current level of global demand.

According to the company, there is also potential to expand the project in the future and add another 120 tonnes of production.

The deal gives the US government first rights to purchase scandium from Sunrise Energy Metals, with production expected to start in late 2028.

However, there are some risks for this...
body.zh: 帕克斯 (Parkes) 附近的菲尔菲尔德 (Fifield) 镇位于悉尼以西约 6 小时车程处，根据上次人口普查，该镇约有 130 人。现在，该镇已成为美国政府一项重大战略行动的中心。 美国陆军部已承诺向澳大利亚矿业公司 Sunrise Energy Metals 提供 4 亿美元（约合 5.66 亿美元）的有条件贷款，该公司希望在中国境外提供全球第一批关键矿物供应。 钪在澳大利亚和美国均被列为重要矿物，表明其在航空航天和国防领域的战略重要性。 这笔贷款是美国政府寻求安全的关键矿产供应链以减少对中国供应依赖的又一篇章。但成功需要持续的投资和政府支持。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 钪是一种高度战略性金属，用于生产最先进战斗机所需的超高强度合金。它还用于固体氧化物燃料电池，这对于为人工智能（AI）数据中心提供可靠的电力至关重要。 首先，北美、欧洲和亚洲国防支出的大幅增加以及耗电的人工智能数据中心的投资热潮推动了对钪的需求。 其次，中国对包括钪在内的稀土元素实行全面的出口管制，导致全球市场供应持续短缺，推高价格。 这些出口管制旨在维持中国在关键矿产供应链中的主导地位，并减缓美国国防和工业基础的发展。 尽管如此，钪的市场仍然很小。据美国地质调查局统计，2025年全球仅消耗了60吨金属。 钪的含量通常非常少。因此，到目前为止，它仅作为镍和钛加工的副产品生产。 这就是 Sunrise Energy Metals 项目的与众不同之处——拟建矿山的钪矿床浓度足够高，可以成为世界上第一个主要钪来源。 如果生产继续进行，并兑现到2028年每年生产60吨高纯钪的承诺，这将足以完全满足目前的全球需求水平。 该公司表示，未来还有可能扩大该项目，再增加120吨的产量。 该交易赋予美国政府从 Sunrise Energy Metals 购买钪的优先权，预计将于 2028 年底开始生产。 然而，这样做也存在一些风险……

title.en: Worldview 'gulf' behind strained Australia-China ties, former Australian ambassador says
title.zh: 前澳大利亚大使称，世界观“鸿沟”是澳中关系紧张的幕后原因

summary.en: Australia's former ambassador to China identified "diverging worldviews" as a key obstacle to fostering a robust relationship between the two nations.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚前驻华大使指出，“世界观差异”是澳中两国建立健康关系的主要障碍之一。

body.en:
Australia is unlikely ever to have a true partnership with China due to a mismatch of worldviews, rendering it pointless to pursue that goal, the nation's former top diplomat to China says.

But in an analysis piece for the Lowy Institute, Australia's former ambassador to China Graham Fletcher noted several wildcards, such as Chinese military action in Taiwan , could still disrupt the "modest new normal" of the relationship.

The change in government at the 2022 federal election acted as a circuit-breaker in increasingly fraught dealings between the nations, although they had still been marred by intimidatory military encounters involving Chinese forces, he said.

China sparked widespread international condemnation over its launch of a ballistic missile into the South Pacific in July following the signing of a landmark mutual defence alliance between Australia and Fiji.

The Albanese government sought to stabilise relations with China after diplomatic tensions peaked during the COVID-19 pandemic under then-prime minister Scott Morrison's leadership.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

China slapped $20 billion in trade sanctions on Australian exports, measures that have slowly been wound back.

China is Australia's largest trading partner and is the destination for about a third of the nation's exports.

Fletcher said China had not given up hope of drawing Australia closer into its orbit, while Australia was more focused on consolidating its current relationship.

"But this relationship is unlikely ever to become genuinely close — like the relaxed, intimate fellowship Australia enjoys with like-minded partners elsewhere in its region and beyond," he said.

"The gulf in terms of diverging world views and national security agendas is simply too wide.

"It would be pointless for Canberra to pursue such a goal; it recognises this and is realistic."

The "mismatch" of world views made the relationship vulnerable to disruption, with key risks including another round of serious disagreements or the cataclysm of a conflict, including the use of force against Taiwan.

"An upheaval or conflict is always a possibility, though not in my opinion a strong one at present," the former diplomat said.

Australia would be on firmer ground when facing China if policies had cross-party support and politicians did not "seek to exploit difficulties for domestic advantage", Fletcher said.

"Bipartisanship produces policy consistency and limits China's ability to play games within the Australian system," he said.

body.zh: 澳大利亚前驻华最高外交官表示，由于世界观不匹配，澳大利亚不太可能与中国建立真正的伙伴关系，因此追求这一目标毫无意义。 但澳大利亚前驻华大使格雷厄姆·弗莱彻在洛伊研究所的一篇分析文章中指出，一些不确定因素，例如中国在台湾的军事行动，仍然可能破坏两国关系的“适度新常态”。 他说，2022 年联邦选举中的政府更迭为两国之间日益令人担忧的交易起到了断路器的作用，尽管它们仍然受到涉及中国军队的恐吓性军事冲突的损害。 在澳大利亚和斐济签署具有里程碑意义的共同防御联盟后，中国于 7 月向南太平洋发射弹道导弹，引发了国际社会的广泛谴责。 在时任总理斯科特·莫里森 (Scott Morrison) 的领导下，新冠肺炎 (COVID-19) 疫情期间外交紧张局势达到顶峰后，阿尔巴尼亚政府寻求稳定与中国的关系。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 中国对澳大利亚出口产品实施了价值 200 亿美元的贸易制裁，但这些措施已慢慢取消。 中国是澳大利亚最大的贸易伙伴，也是该国约三分之一出口的目的地。 弗莱彻表示，中国并未放弃将澳大利亚拉近其轨道的希望，而澳大利亚则更专注于巩固当前的关系。 “但这种关系不太可能变得真正亲密——就像澳大利亚与其地区及其他地方志同道合的伙伴所享有的轻松、亲密的友谊一样，”他说。 “世界观和国家安全议程的分歧实在太大了。 “堪培拉追求这样的目标是毫无意义的；它认识到这一点并且是现实的。” 世界观的“不匹配”使得两国关系容易受到破坏，其主要风险包括新一轮严重分歧或爆发冲突，包括对台湾使用武力。 这位前外交官表示：“动乱或冲突总是有可能发生，尽管我认为目前可能性不大。” 弗莱彻表示，如果政策得到跨党派支持，并且政客们不“寻求利用困难谋取国内利益”，那么澳大利亚在面对中国时将会更加坚定。 “两党合作带来了政策的一致性，并限制了中国在澳大利亚体系内玩弄游戏的能力，”他说。 弗莱彻于 2019 年至 2023 年担任澳大利亚驻中国大使，并于 2014 年领导谈判团队，帮助两国签署了自由贸易协定……

reflection.en: When nations face a "gulf" in worldviews, the path to peace can seem daunting. title.en: More than one million evacuated, flights cancelled, as Typhoon Dolphin hits China

summary.en: Typhoon Dolphin has led to the evacuation of over one million people and the cancellation of flights in China. The cyclone previously swept across Japan, causing injuries to six people and cutting power to more than 50,000 buildings.

body.en:
Typhoon Dolphin brought heavy rain to eastern China on Monday, causing hundreds of flight cancellations even as the storm weakened and some cities resumed public transport.

The typhoon had already swept across Japan’s southern Okinawa prefecture, injuring six people and cutting power to more than 50,000 buildings.

It then made landfall near Yuhuan in eastern Zhejiang province on Sunday evening, China's meteorological authorities said.

The storm packed maximum sustained winds of 151km/h near its centre at landfall, equivalent to a Category 1 hurricane on the Saffir-Simpson scale.

Authorities had moved offshore workers to safety, ordered vessels back to port and increased checks at reservoirs, mountain streams, landslide-prone areas, construction sites and tourist locations.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The weather system lost power after making landfall, with China's National Meteorological Centre (NMC) issuing its least severe typhoon alert on Monday morning.

However, the NMC warned that parts of east and central China would continue to receive heavy rain for the next day.

The typhoon had triggered a top-level alert over the weekend, prompting over 1,000 flight cancellations and tens of thousands of evacuations.

Transport was widely disrupted across the east of the country, and more than one million people were evacuated from their homes.

Nine hundred and forty-three flights from Shanghai's two main passenger airports were cancelled, the airport authority said in an online post.

A 42-year-old tourist from Guangdong said he was stranded in Shanghai after his family's flight, scheduled to depart on Sunday, was cancelled due to Typhoon Dolphin.

He said the family had been rebooked on a flight at 10pm on Monday, although they were unsure whether it would be able to take off.

"To us Guangdong people, this typhoon is as ordinary as having a meal and feeling the wind. It's just part of everyday life," he said, adding that the storm did not appear particularly strong by the standards of China's southern coast.

In neighbouring Zhejiang province, the city of Wenzhou relocated more than 900,000 residents and opened more than 1,000 emergency shelters.

In Fujian province, authorities evacuated 98,900 people from high-risk areas after raising the typhoon emergency response to Level 3, according to Xinhua. Zhejiang, Shanghai and Jiangsu have also activated Level 3 emergency responses.

Fujian maritime authorities said 55 coastal passenger ferry routes had been suspended, all 115 offshore construction projects had been halted, and 290 construction vessels had been moved to sheltered waters.

But rising everyday costs mean saving is difficult, leaving her feeling as though the traditional path into adulthood is becoming increasingly out of reach.

"I feel like I'm doing everything you're told you're supposed to do. I'm working, I'm studying, I'm saving when I can," she told SBS News.

Sophie's experience reflects a broader trend identified in a new five-year analysis of the Australian Youth Barometer.

The Monash Centre for Youth Policy and Education Practice has tracked more than 2,700 Australians aged 18 to 24 since 2021, examining their experiences across work, education, housing, wellbeing, relationships and civic participation.

Its latest report describes young Australians as living through a "polycrisis" of overlapping economic, social, environmental and political pressures that compound one another.

Affordable housing was the biggest issue young people flagged as needing urgent action, rising from 60 per cent in 2022 to 82 per cent in 2025.

Also recognised as needing urgent action was employment opportunities, which rose from 48 in 2022 to 64 per cent in 2025. Climate change was identified as an issue needing urgent action by 44 per cent in 2025, falling from 47 per cent in 2022.

Monash University professor Lucas Walsh, the report's lead author, says the significance of the findings is in how those issues connect.

"These are all embedded within the idea of a polycrisis, which involves overlapping independent events in crisis that intersect and amplify each other," he told SBS News.

Walsh said the study started tracking young Australians at the height of the COVID-19 pandemic, providing a five-year window into how their lives and priorities have changed as the country moved through and beyond it.

He describes the pandemic as a "flash of light into more persistent problems" which exposed pressures that were already disproportionately affecting young people.

"I don't necessarily expect to own a house tomorrow, but I would like to feel like it's something I could realistically work towards. It can be discouraging to feel like the goalposts for how much I need to have saved, how much I need to be earning or even spending to get a home keeps changing," she said.

Wendy Stone, a professor of housing and social policy at Swinburne University, told SBS News that secure housing provides the foundation that young people need to establish independence, work, study and relationships.

body.en:
The Fair Work Commission has issued a new minimum standards order for gig workers, including on-demand food, beverage and grocery delivery drivers.

The standards, released on Tuesday, stipulate that on-demand delivery workers must be paid a minimum rate of $31.30 or up to $32 per hour, depending on the type of vehicle used. The order also specifies that delivery platforms must insure workers for on-the-job injuries.

The Transport Workers' Union (TWU), which represents Australian gig workers, said these changes have been years in the making . The TWU initially applied for the minimum standards order in 2024, alongside food delivery platforms Uber Eats and DoorDash.

In a joint statement provided to SBS News, TWU national secretary Michael Kaine described the new standards as "world-leading".

"The world is looking on as gig workers in Australia win new rights and protections that will change their lives, after years of campaigning for a better industry," Kaine said.

Employment and Workplace Relations Minister Amanda Rishworth also believes the order is a "big step" in providing more robust worker protections .

She said it means "food and delivery workers don't have to trade off flexibility for fairer protections".

The TWU said "hundreds of thousands" of delivery workers in Australia will be impacted by the new orders.

They specifically apply to employee-like workers who are engaged through digital on-demand delivery platforms — such as Uber Eats and DoorDash — and mainly deliver consumables (food, beverages or liquor) or supermarket groceries .

These workers will be entitled to a guaranteed minimum hourly rate for their "engaged time" between accepting an order and completing the delivery. This is also called an "earnings floor".

People operating bicycles or e-bikes will be paid $31.30 an hour. For motorbikes, this increases to $31.80 per hour, and workers driving cars will earn $32 per hour.

According to the interim order, platforms will calculate a worker's total earnings over a period of up to 21 days. If a worker "has been paid less than the earnings floor in an earnings period, the digital labour platform operator will pay a top-up amount to ... make up the difference", it said.

title.en: Opposition to promise migration cuts as frontbencher refuses to confirm figure
title.zh: 反对党承诺削减移民，前座议员拒绝确认具体数字

summary.en: The opposition's housing spokesperson, Andrew Bragg, is set to unveil a new housing and migration policy, which includes proposed migration cuts, during an address at the National Press Club.
summary.zh: 反对党住房事务发言人安德鲁·布拉格将在国家新闻俱乐部发表演讲，推广一项新的住房和移民政策，其中包括提议削减移民人数。

body.en:
A senior Coalition frontbencher has refused to confirm specifics of his party's plan to cut migration numbers, despite a formal announcement expected to be made later on Wednesday.

Opposition housing spokesperson Andrew Bragg will use a major speech at the National Press Club on Wednesday to call for a cut to net overseas migration levels by nearly half to meet the rate of new housing supply being built.

Treasury modelling published in the May budget expects net overseas migration to fall from 301,000 to 225,000 by the end of this decade.

But the Opposition frontbencher will advocate for an average annual net overseas migration rate of 180,000 to make up for a housing shortfall.

"A [net overseas migration] reduction on this scale is manageable and in line with reductions we have managed in recent history," Bragg will say.

"Lifting migration standards, and analysing them carefully each year, is crucial to ensure integrity and public trust in our migration settings."

But his colleague, Opposition treasury spokesperson Tim Wilson, backed away from confirming the number just hours before the speech.

Wilson was pressed on the topic during a News24 interview, in which he said: "I don't think you should bank that at all (the 180,000 figure). Let's just wait and see, firstly, what Senator Bragg's saying in his speech".

"We haven't made an announcement about where we're going to be going into the next election, but our focus is actually about what we need to do to invest in the long-term growth and success of our country," he said.

The centrepiece of Bragg's speech will be a commitment to replace the National Construction Code with a new 80-page "Basic Australian Standard".

The codes set minimum requirements for the safety, health, amenity, accessibility, and sustainability of certain buildings, as detailed in over 2,000 pages.

The Coalition's new standards will focus on cost-effective structural, fire safety and health-related building standards.

"Anything else like mandatory ramps, flattened shower flooring or reinforced walls would be optional extras," Bragg will say.

Labor announced it would freeze the National Construction Code following its productivity roundtable in mid-2026.

Housing Minister Clare O'Neil brushed off calls from the Coalition to cut the construction standards to 200 pages earlier in 2026.

"I've talked to builders about that, they laugh their heads off. That is absolutely ridiculous," O'Neil told the National Press Club in May.

summary.en: Flight delays are a familiar frustration for many travellers, but experts say the reason behind them is often less visible.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
On Tuesday, many Australians arrived at the airport with their plane waiting on the tarmac and clear skies overhead — only to discover their flight had been delayed.

Around 200 flights moving through Melbourne and Perth Airports were forecast to experience delays, according to a daily plan issued by Airservices Australia.

In Sydney, 138 flights were expected to be impacted by ground delays of around 43 minutes, in part due to strong winds, the government-owned air traffic management organisation said.

title.en: I used ice at work in secret. When I was jailed for the second time, I knew I had to stop

summary.en: Tahlia, who secretly used crystal meth at work, found herself jailed for a second time. It was during this second prison sentence that she realized she needed to change her life and "rewire her brain" to overcome her addiction.

body.en:
What do extreme sports, doomscrolling, addiction, Parkinson's disease, and ADHD all have in common? Dopamine. This crucial neurotransmitter helps facilitate reward, motivation, memory and movement within the body, but are its effects always beneficial? Watch Insight episode Chasing Dopamine on SBS On Demand.

Chasing Dopamine episode • Insight • News And Current Affairs • 51m Content warning: This article references drug use and addiction.

When I was 18 years old at a party, someone offered me ice (crystal meth), and I said yes as I was fresh out of a breakup and wanted to escape reality.

Before I knew it, 10 years had passed, and I no longer recognised the woman that stood in front of the mirror.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

I didn't really know who I was and placed all my worth in what other people thought about me. And I actively avoided rejection or confrontation, which meant I had no boundaries and never said no. I also had a high appetite for risk, because I thought it would make me look cool and be liked.

For the next 10 years, I would smoke amphetamines every single day — chasing dopamine and trying to regulate my emotions in an unhealthy way.

Dopamine is a neurotransmitter in the brain that contributes to our motivation, reward systems, and habit development. Dopamine is not itself addictive, but the associated substances, behaviours or activities that cause the brain to release dopamine can be.

I liken smoking ice to the dopamine centre of your brain lighting up like a Christmas tree. Your dopamine receptors are the lights, and it takes so much power to light the tree. But you need more and more of the drug to reach the feeling of your first high, to power the lights. And with regular drug use over time, the dopamine receptors start to die off, and your brain needs more drugs to feel the same high.

I experienced a full spectrum in that decade: The hard times would send me further into my addiction, and I'd try escape the reality I had created for myself.

The good times would make me believe I didn't need to change — that I could manage it all. I would still go to work, look after my health in other ways, study at university, pay my rent and maintained my relationships with family.

But all the while, I would sneak off into the toilets to smoke a pipe — just to feel normal.

Keeping something like that hidden for long periods of time is exhausting because you can never keep up the charade. Eventually, the walls start to crumble around you.

The cycle of being able to keep it all together was getting shorter and shorter.

body.en:
While Australian borrowers have avoided another interest rate hike, some economists warn the relief may be short-lived, tipping November as the next key month to watch for a potential rate rise.

The Reserve Bank of Australia's (RBA) decision on Tuesday to hold the cash rate steady at 4.35 per cent was widely expected, with 92 per cent of experts and economists surveyed by comparison site Finder correctly predicting the outcome.

However, 44 per cent of the panellists still expect at least one more rate rise this year.

Of those expecting an increase, 69 per cent nominated November as the most likely month, prompting Finder to say "November is circled".

KPMG chief economist Brendan Rynne told ABC News the market was anticipating a November hike, giving the RBA more time to assess upcoming economic data.

He said the September-quarter inflation figures and labour market data will give the central bank more information before it makes its next major decision.

"One would expect the rate hike still has to be on the table at some point," he said.

He noted the economy was still running at full capacity, with unemployment at 4.4 per cent and public sector spending continuing to add to demand.

With household spending still relatively strong, Rynne said the RBA may ultimately need to rely on higher interest rates to slow demand and bring inflation back towards its 2 to 3 per cent target range.

The RBA has already raised interest rates three times this year as it attempts to bring inflation back towards the midpoint of its target range.

"The only way we're going to see a drop in spending in this country is probably from the household sector," Rynne said.

A further rate rise would put additional pressure on households by increasing the cost of borrowing, potentially reducing consumer spending.

Rynne said falling house prices could also affect how Australians spend, through what economists call the "wealth effect".

"As we feel like our house prices are starting to decline, we feel less wealthy and consume less," he said.

But the strength of the labour market means households are still spending, despite ongoing cost-of-living pressures.

"We've never had more Australians employed than we have at the moment," Rynne said.

The major banks have also shifted their forecasts following lower-than-expected inflation data released last month.

Westpac recently scrapped its prediction of an August rate rise and said it now expects the RBA to leave rates unchanged for the rest of 2026.

ANZ is also forecasting an extended hold at 4.35 per cent, while the Commonwealth Bank expects rates to remain unchanged into 2027.

title.en: Australia is rolling out a new defence against deadly bird flu
title.zh: 澳大利亚正在推出针对致命禽流感的新防御措施

summary.en: Native species in captivity will be prioritised for protection from the deadly H5 strain spreading across the country.

body.en:
Birds most at risk of contracting the deadly H5 strain of bird flu will be vaccinated in a bid to stop the virus from decimating vulnerable species.

The first vaccines were set to roll out in coming days, Agriculture Minister Julie Collins announced on Tuesday.

Species in captivity will be prioritised for the vaccination based on their vulnerability and risk of catching the virus.

"We've been very clear that we cannot stop the H5 bird flu from spreading amongst wild birds. But we can take action to protect the species most at risk, and the vaccination is now part of that response," Collins told reporters in Canberra.

"Australians should expect to see more spread and larger numbers, particularly of dead birds and mass mortalities around the country from the H5 bird flu, we have been very clear that this will continue to spread across the country."

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

While wild birds will be vaccinated if possible, the priority will be on birds in captivity.

The federal government says it has secured 1,500 vials of the vaccine, worth about $2 million.

"The doses vary depending in those vials of the size of the bird," Collins said.

"We have sufficient vaccines in terms of undertaking the initial vaccination program, but we've also been very clear we're working with states and territories, and if we need more vaccines, we're able to secure those."

Australia's chief veterinary officer Beth Cookson said vaccines would not be the 'silver bullet' to stop the spread of the bird flu.

"It is not a standalone solution. Biosecurity will remain important, the protection of these species," she said.

"We have been working very carefully for the last 18 months as part of our national preparedness to make sure that we have safety and efficacy data available to us."

More than 200 bird flu deaths have been reported, with the majority of cases in South Australia.

While the flu was first detected in migratory birds, it soon spread to native species.

Collins said reporting of the number of bird flu cases would also change due to the spread of the virus among species.

Counting the number of cases was no longer the most accurate picture of how the disease was spreading, the minister said.

"Our reporting will evolve to focus on confirmed H5 events and the developments that matter most, where the disease is spreading, new locations or species affected in emerging areas of risk," she said.

The deadly strain has not been detected in the poultry sector or in the broader agricultural industry to date.

reflection.en: This story draws attention to creation care and environmental responsibility. Genesis 2:15 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with faithful stewardship of creation, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
